tabs.label: EVERY– Grubu (Her…)
rows: Everybody is here. / Everyone wants to go to heaven.
Everything is okay. / I want to eat everything in the fridge.
Everywhere is green. / I can live everywhere.

tabs.label: SOME– Grubu (Biri / Bir şey…)
rows: Somebody knocked on the door. / Someone is waiting for you outside.
Something is wrong. / I have something to tell you. / Give them something to eat.
I need to go somewhere different. / Ali lives somewhere in Ordu. / I left my keys somewhere in the kitchen.
